title: Chase letter after June 1967 meeting of base UFO officers
place_text: United States Air Force / Condon Committee

tellings.quote: >> And then there was another letter that Chase had written after having a big meeting in June of ' 67 with other base UFO officers

plain: In June 1967 an Air Force officer named Lewis Chase held a big meeting with other base UFO officers, the people at each Air Force base assigned to handle UFO reports, and afterward wrote a letter about it. Robert Salas, a former Air Force nuclear missile officer, brings it up as a document from the time the Air Force was paying the University of Colorado to study UFOs. He tells it as part of the paper trail on how the Air Force handled reports of UFOs near nuclear missile bases.
